physics_goals.quote: Understanding the source of the MiniBooNE excess is MicroBooNE's primary physics goal.
physics_goals.value: Determine the source of the MiniBooNE low-energy excess using a technology that can distinguish electrons from photons

physics_goals.quote: the world's largest dataset of neutrino-argon interactions
MicroBooNE will provide enormous technical experience in the construction, operation, and analysis of a large LArTPC.
physics_goals.value: Provide technical experience in the construction, operation and analysis of a large liquid argon time projection chamber for future experiments such as DUNE

summary.plain: A 170-tonne liquid-argon camera on Fermilab's Booster neutrino beam, built to find out what caused an earlier experiment's mysterious signal, and along the way to measure neutrino collisions with unprecedented clarity.
summary.technical: Single-phase LArTPC accelerator neutrino experiment on the BNB, 470 m baseline, 170 t total / 90 t active argon mass, 2.6 m drift; took data October 2015 - 2021, primarily to test the MiniBooNE low-energy excess and to develop LArTPC technology and cross-section measurements for DUNE.
